titles.title: Cho Đến Khi Trở Thành Một Đóa Lan

description:
Life means living for someone else. Always living for pitiful neighbors, her mother, and her aunt, Ji-eun meets Eui-tae, the older brother of her only neighborhood friend Eui-ju, at Eui-ju's funeral during the winter of her third year of high school. 

“You must be Yang Ji-eun.” 

Even though he can't even hold chopsticks properly and has an uncertain job, she finds him scary yet keeps finding herself drawn to him, eventually bringing him side dishes and even tutoring him. The most pitiful man she has ever met. Ji-eun’s feelings, which started out of pity, gradually begin to blossom into something else. 

“I like you.” 

“Ji-eun, you’re the first person to ever tell me they like me.” 

*** 

Life is just about surviving. Eui-tae, who thought he was all alone in the world, develops desires for the very first time after meeting Ji-eun. Hoping to spend his whole life with her. Hoping this very moment will last forever.
